Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner erroneously concluded that "Circus of Love" was released more recently than "The Kiss of Evil." While identifying the release year of "Circus of Love" as 1954 earlier in the conversation, the Planner incorrectly referenced "Circus of Love (2015)" in the final analysis without any supporting evidence for a 2015 release. This misinterpretation led to the incorrect conclusion that "Circus of Love" was released more recently than "The Kiss of Evil" (2011). This error was due to a failure to verify the 2015 release claim and a misunderstanding of the data provided by WebSurfer.
